description: This PHP source file defines the 'CountryService' class, which provides various methods for retrieving country and province data from the database, including fetching lists, by name, or code. It uses a data access object (CountryDao) and includes normalization functionality through a trait.

classes.name: CountryService
classes.description: Service class that handles operations related to countries and provinces, including data retrieval and normalization.

methods.name: getCountryDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the CountryDao object for data access.

methods.name: setCountryDao
methods.description: Sets the CountryDao object, mainly for dependency injection/testing.

methods.name: getCountryList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all countries.

methods.name: getProvinceList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all provinces.

methods.name: getCountryByCountryName
methods.description: Fetches a Country entity based on its name.

methods.name: getCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Fetches a Country entity based on its code.

methods.name: getProvinceByProvinceCode
methods.description: Fetches a Province entity based on its code.

methods.name: getCountryArray
methods.description: Returns an array of normalized country data.

methods.name: getProvinceArray
methods.description: Returns an array of normalized province data.
